attack_chain_description: Raynor holds iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion on his own policy; an older policy version grants admin; setting it as default gives admin.
notes: Non-default policy versions are not ingested by Cartography, so the admin capability is inferred from the action, not visible as an admin statement. Verified in Neo4j: Raynor's statement is Allow, action [iam:Get*, iam:List*, iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion], resource [*].
